concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone macOS app logo exploration for Motionpaper, a small app that keeps native aerial landscape wallpapers continuously moving. Create ONE polished original logo, no text. Concept 1: a single broad flowing sheet or ribbon of paper folds into a memorable lowercase-m-like wave silhouette, evoking both paper and effortless continuous motion. Compact, simple bold silhouette, beautifully controlled curves, subtle material depth and restrained luminous color transitions, contemporary macOS-quality finish. It must remain recognizable at small app-icon sizes. Center the complete isolated mark on a square canvas with generous clear margin. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha, including all surrounding space and open gaps. No background tile, no rounded-square container, no surface, no environment, no checkerboard painted into the image, no text, no watermark, no mockup, no tiny decorative details. Deliver one large logo only.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone macOS app logo exploration for Motionpaper, an app that keeps native aerial wallpapers moving. Create ONE original refined logo, no text. Concept 2: a gently curling sheet of wallpaper contains an extremely simplified flowing landscape, two or three broad rolling landforms and a tiny sun, with one lifted corner that makes the whole sheet feel alive and in motion. Distinctive compact silhouette, mostly front-facing with a slight elegant curl. Sophisticated minimal illustration with softly sculpted depth, restrained harmonious colors, beautiful edge finish. Prioritize immediate association with a living landscape wallpaper, clarity at small app-icon sizes, minimal shapes. Center the isolated complete logo on a square canvas with generous clear margin. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha around the silhouette. The sheet is the subject itself; no extra enclosing square icon tile. No backdrop, floor, checkerboard painted into the image, typography, text, watermark, labels, mockup, or ornamental particles. One large logo only.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone macOS app logo exploration for Motionpaper, an app that continuously plays native aerial landscape wallpapers. Create ONE original premium minimal logo, no text. Concept 3: a fluid continuous loop shaped like an open landscape picture frame, with the lower edge transforming into one broad rolling wave sweeping through the frame. Suggest an endlessly moving landscape through the structural shape itself. A simple almost-flat graphic with precise bold curves, subtle color depth, coherent refined finish and a strong readable silhouette. Distinct from a generic play button and distinct from an infinity-symbol stock logo. Clean negative space within the loop remains truly transparent. Center the complete isolated symbol on a square canvas with generous clear margin, optimized for recognition at small app-icon sizes. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha, no background tile or squircle, no floor, no backdrop or checkerboard painted into the pixels. No lettering, wordmark, watermark, labels, mockup, particles, or additional symbols. One large logo only.
